draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.13, the 140th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 9th of 15 at TE. He went 120th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jake Ferguson. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (9th percentile), 10-yard split (6th percentile). College production: 786 receiving yards in 2024, 4th of 15 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 16 career games and 10 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: catch rate 80.0% (91st percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 tight end who played: 357 receiving yards against a median of 158, above the norm.
